statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-50526 (GHSA-55jh-fwmh-39m4) is a tampering issue in the .NET SDK container image build (Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers): improper link resolution lets a local attacker inject resources that can be incorporated into container images built by other users on the same machine. Microsoft lists Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers as affected through the .NET 9.0.17 release and fixed in the .NET 9.0.18 release, which ships .NET SDK 9.0.119 and 9.0.316 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-55jh-fwmh-39m4, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/415, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/9.0/9.0.18/9.0.18.md). The fix moves the blob cache to a per-user directory and validates the digest of downloaded and cached blobs (https://github.com/dotnet/sdk/commit/73033310d9b0a02fa72347e16c15c152cb501a9b, https://github.com/dotnet/sdk/commit/53a05132ae43043e39eafdc61b364d1a9f0931f5). DHI dotnet9-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 9 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 242 packages of the eleven published builds (9.0.12-r0, 9.0.13-r0, 9.0.14-r0, 9.0.15-r0, 9.0.16-r0, 9.0.17-r0, 9.0.18-r0, 9.0.20-r0, 9.0.21-r0, 9.0.22-r0 and 9.0.23-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the debug packages and the files inside the nupkg, zip and tar.gz archives they hold. Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers.dll is in two places in each build: the Containers tasks of the .NET SDK held by dotnet9-runtime-bootstrap, and the Microsoft.NET.Build.Containers nupkg in dotnet9-runtime-artifacts. Both carry the SDK version that matches the build (SDK 9.0.113 in 9.0.12-r0 up to SDK 9.0.124 in 9.0.23-r0). The copies in the first 6 builds (9.0.12-r0 to 9.0.17-r0) are SDK 9.0.118 or earlier and lack the cache digest validation; every copy from 9.0.18-r0 on (SDK 9.0.119 and later) contains the digest-checking blob copy routine (CopyToAndVerifyAsync) and the "Digest validation failed for cached blob" message that the fix adds. The range ends at 9.0.18-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
